commit_scope: Add a bounded unlisted-public Form-grounded dialogue CPU lane with persistent receipts, crash recovery, source disclosure gates, MCP access, expiry, and removal.

local_validation.details: Form source preflight returned zero errors, warnings, and unresolved calls; Go/Rust/TypeScript returned 63; direct fkwu returned 63; 97 focused Docker/config/dialogue/MCP/federation tests and 51 shared grounding/MCP-substrate regression tests passed with Python warnings promoted to errors. The full local PR guard passed 403 selected API tests, the production web build, and the live worktree runtime check; the exact CI-equivalent full API suite passed all 2119 tests with every Python warning promoted to an error after the application-recipe ownership set, nested kernel-core source reader, and final review repairs were healed. Strict spec, evidence, index, maintainability, and git diff gates passed. The kernel submodule's healed form-cli boundary was regenerated into source-bound bootstrap and Darwin carriers; a cache-empty standard lane copied the committed binary without clang, answered the new carrier identity and pong, the form-cli band returned 524287 on all four arms, and the FNRI source, native dispatch, and standalone witnesses passed. The committed source-stamp verifier accepted carrier-id form-cli-carrier-v2, the native carrier reported that its Form program runs on fkwu, and the public dialogue boundary refuses publication of any nonempty rented answer, keeping remote-generated answer bytes at zero. The Windows full-model composition receipt now resolves the nested source checkout and flat image layout through one runtime directory; all six previously misrouted four-way gates passed locally at 255, 1023, 31, 255, 255, and 2097151, with a contract test guarding every executable validate path. The regeneration recipe now reuses the canonical witnessed stamp instead of a drift-prone duplicate source list. Two independent AI review rounds were run after local proof; the second round's one launch blocker and four hardening signals were embodied and re-witnessed. Twenty-eight GitHub AI-review threads were also embodied: accepted dialogue requests execute their real six-field envelope in Form before persistence, federation offers/reads receive operation-specific encoded shapes in Form, idempotent retry repairs atomically published message indexes, potentially blocking HTTP/MCP Form admission runs in worker threads after known capacity and pacing refusals are screened, federation index read-modify-replace operations are serialized across API processes, running-dialogue release/reaping executes outside both async request loops, the federation recipe resolves from the application package in both source and deployed image layouts, the capacity/rate gate remains atomically held through Form admission and row persistence, and Uvicorn trusts forwarded caller identity only from the observed internal Docker proxy range. Later review rounds moved same-process admission into a nonblocking pre-session slot and PostgreSQL admission onto pg_try_advisory_xact_lock, moved both HTTP and MCP polling into worker threads, installed the Linux process inspector used by ownership-safe reaping, added ownership-safe Windows task-tree termination, moved proxy and federation-store settings onto the shared file-backed configuration precedence, kept the container listener aligned with its fixed expose, healthcheck, and proxy port at 8000, retained the non-public removal-capability hash so identical retries succeed while different capabilities remain rejected, preserved explicit zero MCP timeouts so the shared 10-second floor refuses them before admission, replaced MCP timeout coercion with real-integer admission so nonfinite and noninteger values return structured errors, and made shutdown join and clear its worker before a same-process restart can create the next worker. The final review repairs pass the actual six encoded values through Form, let Form return independently verified content-addressed message and edge identities, persist only those opaque Form identities in Python, contain dialogue storage failures inside sanitized per-tool MCP results so a failed batch member cannot abort its siblings, fsync each graph carrier's parent directory after atomic replacement before acknowledging persistence, serialize native federation kernel invocations through a one-run CPU lane, and stage Form source in a temporary file instead of the operating-system argument vector. A persistent 150,000-byte offer witness crosses that file-backed path through real fkwu and returns valid Form identities. The staged runner now resolves both the nested source stdlib and the production image's flattened /app/form/form-stdlib layout; a simulated image witness verifies that both core and offered recipe reach the carrier. On Windows the bridge resolves Git Bash from PATH or the setup-supported Program Files location, so PowerShell hosts need not modify PATH; the off-PATH fallback has a direct witness. Every staged Form run now starts in an isolated process group, kills and reaps the entire POSIX or Windows process tree on timeout, and normalizes timeout into RuntimeError so public callers receive the documented retryable 503 instead of an unhandled 500. Native federation offers and their SQL projections now run outside the async event loop; the concurrency witness held Form open while another public request completed. The proxy witnesses preserve two public peers through one Traefik/kernel-router carrier while refusing a forged forwarded identity from an untrusted peer. The concurrency witnesses held dialogue admission, polling, release, and native federation identity construction open while public information surfaces remained responsive, refused a second admission before another session or Form process opened, and preserved both IDs in a deliberately widened two-process federation race on five consecutive runs. The broad re-witness also exposed and healed a pre-existing import-order seam by registering verification hash-chain models before unified schema creation; its formerly failing fresh-database request passed alone and within the 2119-test body. The full smoke carrier now selects Uvicorn's maintained websockets-sansio adapter explicitly, healing both third-party deprecation signals; direct native acceptance/refusal calls and all warning-strict suites passed afterward.
